newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes continue stronger, led by sweet grades.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes continue stronger, led by sweet grades.

text.p: U.S. crude prices gained strength Friday morning, rallying for both sweet and sour grades on increased refiner demand, traders said.
Outright crude values advanced on support from heating oil buying, brought on by extreme tightness in the New York Harbor and a short cold spell in the northeastern U.S.

May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was talked around 30 cents higher from late Thursday at $19.65-75 a barrel. Strength in the front month blew open a wider premium for the May WTI over June, with screen spreads around 12-13 cts and talk on the NYMEX floor at 10 cts, traders said.
